public_entry.sharedTemplateContract: The login page may use mountPageTemplate with layout=standalone. Standalone owns only the explicit root, heading/status/primary/support/composer slots, and the shared detail/focus carrier; it renders no business top navigation, no four-corner shell, no display-preference subscription, and no authenticated business read. session_check remains the login controller's public GET /api/auth/session boundary.

login_surface.layoutConsumer: The page controller keeps the valid pairing form, status/error, safe same-origin next, retry, exit, input retention, and focus behavior. It must not attach business navigation or authenticated data to the standalone template.

render_auth_terminal.terminalContract: Success returns to the requested same-origin entry; typed rejection or request failure stays on the standalone login surface with input retained and the existing return/retry/exit actions. The shared template only supplies layout and detail focus; it does not submit pairing, read auth state, or trigger automatic login loops.
